clips.title: The story
paras: Gilthares Firebough is held at Northwatch Hold after Alliance forces sink his ship off the Barrens coast. The elf deckhand wants to reach his captain in Ratchet.

Gilthares Firebough is held in the dungeons at Northwatch Hold. Theramore uses the fortress as its military foothold on the Barrens coast, where its garrison watches for threats. Gilthares had been aboard a ship carrying moonshine along the trade route between Ratchet and Booty Bay when Alliance forces bombarded it and sent it beneath the sea. He alone survived the wreck. The soldiers took him to Northwatch and accused him of being an enemy agent conspiring against the Alliance.

Gilthares says he is only a deckhand who was carrying illicit liquor. With help from Horde forces, he fights his way out of Northwatch Hold and flees north along the shore toward Ratchet. Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun welcomes him back to the crew of the Thalo'dan Privateers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I can't believe you got past the guards. These zealots from Theramore are out of their minds. They sank our ship and imprisoned me, the only survivor. I was called an enemy and threat to the Alliance.
Me! A threat to their great sham of an Alliance? I was a deckhand on a moonshine transport between Ratchet and Booty Bay.
Enough talk. Help me get back to Ratchet will you? Let me know when you're ready and we'll make our break.

clips.title: Completion
paras: And to think, we thought Firebough was long dead!
Your heroics have earned you a place of honor with the Thalo'dan Privateers, friend.
